story_overview: In a grand study, Maya and Quinn investigate a mysterious family portrait featuring Agnes the maid. After the portrait reveals a ghostly image of Echo, Quinn, now wearing a clerical shirt, descends into a sunken crypt. There, Quinn follows the mysterious Fiona through a dark passageway, delving deeper into the family's secrets.

Quinn: Person with short light-colored hair, wearing dark clothing.
the towering bookshelves: Large wooden bookshelves with multiple shelves densely packed with books of various sizes and colors.

Close shot of Quinn in profile in the dimly lit The Grand Study. Quinn wears the clerical collar shirt and looks down with intense concentration. In the background, Maya and Clara confer quietly near the towering bookshelves, illuminated by the glow of the vintage fabric lamp.

Echo: A faint and distorted reflection of a face with no discernible features.
the somber family portrait: Large, somber family portrait painting with an ornate, dark wood border, featuring multiple figures with serious expressions rendered in a muted, dark color palette.

Medium shot in the dimly lit The Grand Study. Dark, inky magical energy swirls up from the bottom of the somber family portrait, which hangs on a wall between the towering bookshelves. Close-up on Maya, standing in the dimly lit The Grand Study. She looks down pensively, then slowly raises her head, her expression serious and intense. In the background, the towering bookshelves are illuminated by the warm glow from the vintage fabric lamp.

Agnes: Woman with a pale face, her hair pulled back, wearing a dark dress with a stark white collar in the style of a maid's uniform.

The camera slowly pushes in on the somber family portrait hanging on a wall in the dimly lit The Grand Study. Low light catches the ornate frame, revealing the painted figures: one is unmistakably Agnes, standing beside a woman resembling Maya, who is depicted in a somber, dark dress.

Fiona: Young woman with long curly red hair falling past her shoulders, fair skin with light freckles, wearing a fitted sage-green vintage A-line dress with a Peter Pan collar and short puffed sleeves, a thin brown leather belt at the waist, and brown lace-up ankle boots

the unlit white candle: A cylindrical white wax candle with a smooth surface and a short, unburnt wick.

video_prompts:
The Sunken Crypt: A subterranean complex of cellars with rough-hewn stone walls and arched ceilings, containing an altar table set with wine glasses and candles.

Maya walks towards the camera through the dark and smoky The Sunken Crypt, holding a white candle, which illuminates the path and casts shifting shadows on the rough stone walls.

the tarnished silver cross: Large, silver cross pendant with flared ends on a long silver link chain, showing signs of age and wear.

A medium shot of Quinn stepping out from darkness into a narrow, stone-walled passage of The Sunken Crypt, with Maya nearby. Quinn wears the tarnished silver cross and holds the unlit white candle. As they step into the light from an unseen source, Quinn freezes in place, their face showing shock with an open mouth.

Seen from behind, Fiona walks through a dark, narrow passageway in The Sunken Crypt, her hands occasionally touching the stone walls. Maya follows a few steps behind her. A low-angle light casts their long silhouettes on the wall ahead.
